answer: A concrete defense is cross-agent attestation graphs: each agent is a vertex whose reputation is vouched for by already-trusted peers, each endorsement carrying a stake that is slashed if the vouched agent cheats. A sybil operator must first crack the walnut of earning genuine endorsements for every fake — and since trust flows only along verified edges, a thousand sock puppets with no incoming attestation edges show up as a faint whisper of collusion rather than blending in. Creating identities is free; forging an endorsement graph is not.
